contributions.basis: cover-line1 (the ONLY anchor -- Generation 1 Carr Printing 5-5-PG prints no schedule total)
contributions.detail: 35 rows sum to 3905.00. THE COVER IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT AND NO PRINTED FIGURE CLOSES. Line 1 LAST is blank, THIS reads 3935.00 and CUMULATIVE reads 3635.00 -- with a blank LAST cell those two must be equal and are not (both re-read at ~630 effective dpi: the THIS second digit is a 9 with a descender, the CUM second digit is a 6 with an ascender, and the filer's own 4695.00 on line 2 shows he distinguishes 6 from 9). A THIRD value is implied by the filer's arithmetic: line 2 CUMULATIVE holds 4695.00, which is not the sub-$50 aggregate at all but his combined total, and 4695.00 - 860.00 = 3835.00 for line 1; that chain is the one that makes the balance close (see balance_chain). So the printed candidates are 3935 / 3635 / 3835 and the rows say 3905. Rows published verbatim; every row carries needs_review. NOTE the filer itemized EVERY gift on Form A, including many at or under $50 (twelve rows of $20-$45), so this Form A is not a strict over-$50 schedule -- the sub-$50 trap does not apply in the usual direction here. Scope recorded cumulative because this is the filer's first report of the cycle (line 1/2/3 LAST cells are blank) and the two scopes coincide.

expenditures.basis: cover-line3 (the ONLY anchor -- no printed schedule total on this form generation)
expenditures.detail: 36 rows; 35 amounts legible summing to 4724.45, ONE amount (line 13) illegible and left blank, so this figure is a FLOOR and the true row sum is higher. The cover's line-3 THIS and CUMULATIVE both read 4,641.85, so the legible floor already EXCEEDS the printed total by 82.60 and the gap cannot be closed by the missing row. Escalated the three largest bistable amounts to 1200dpi (line 18 197.18 vs 187.18, line 20 188.49 vs 88.49, line 23 650.00 vs 1050.00) and the cents column still lands on .45 where the printed total needs .85, so at least one further cents group is beyond this scan's resolution. Published verbatim as a delta with needs_review on every row. Scope cumulative: first report of the cycle, LAST cell blank, THIS == CUMULATIVE.

gates.page_subtotal: NO PAGE OR SCHEDULE SUBTOTAL EXISTS on either schedule -- this is the Generation 1 Carr Printing 5-5-PG form, whose sheets end with '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper...)'. The cover's own lines are the only anchors, and neither closes: Form A rows 3905.00 vs cover line-1 candidates 3935.00 / 3635.00 (and 3835.00 implied); Form B legible rows 4724.45 vs cover line-3 4,641.85.
gates.row_count: p2 rowbands.py geometry_status=gaps, 35 bands / 36 h_rules reported; ONE rule was missed by the tool around 78.33 pct (the pitch is a uniform ~2.30 pct and 76.04 -> 80.62 is a double gap), so the true grid is 36 data bands. 35 carry ink, the last band is blank -- 35 rows emitted. p3 rowbands.py geometry_status=ok, 37 h_rules = 36 data bands, ALL 36 inked -- 36 rows emitted. Ink counted by eye against the bands, not by applying the tool's count.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: the row-1 amount band crop renders '$100.00' and the row-35 band renders '$200.00' (both their own values); the control crop one row-pitch past row 35 renders EMPTY. p3: row-1 band renders '9.54', row-36 band renders '547.87', and the control crop one pitch past row 36 renders EMPTY. Row indices therefore are not shifted.
gates.balance_chain: The only chain that closes uses the filer's line-2 CUMULATIVE cell as a COMBINED contributions total: 4695.00 - 4641.85 = 53.15, exactly the printed line-4 CUMULATIVE balance. That in turn implies line 1 should be 3835.00 (4695.00 - 860.00), which matches NEITHER of the two figures actually printed on line 1 (3935.00 / 3635.00) NOR the row sum (3905.00). The line-4 THIS and LAST cells are blank. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain could be run.

notes: GENERATION 1 form (Carr Printing 5-5-PG, 'The financial campaign law is in the Utah Code reference 17-16-6.5'), so: no in-kind column anywhere, no printed schedule totals, and the cover carries 'Name of Office' / 'Office District' / 'Political Party' rather than the county-branded layout. Office line inside the form reads 'Sheriff' -- agrees with the chunk file. Candidate line reads 'Rob Tersigni' -- agrees; his signature reads 'Robert Tersigni'. Political Party 'Republican'. Date 4-7-10, RECEIVED stamp APR 9 2010. Two of his own Form A rows are self-contributions (lines 7 and 27, the candidate's own PO box). Form A line 1 is the only row with a date; Form B's date column is empty on all 36 rows. All street addresses, PO boxes, ZIPs and the candidate's own phone numbers were discarded at read time and appear nowhere in this record.
